description.value: Vandula Farms is a Canadian-owned plant nursery and farm market located in Tsawwassen, BC, offering a range of indoor and outdoor plants, kokedama, and plant care accessories alongside a farm market. The business operates both a physical retail location and an online shop. Cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen area may find it a useful stop for farm-fresh goods from the market side of the operation.
